# Airbods v0.1.2-preview

- Listening mode + Adaptive strength: **icon-only** toggles (iOS Control Center style) — no wrapping English labels
- Icons: Transparency (inward waves), Adaptive (waveform), Noise Cancellation (nested circles); strength as 1/2/3 bars
- Localized `contentDescription` kept for accessibility (en / zh-CN / zh-TW / zh-HK / ja)
